facts.text: Lagoon New York is a concept store, gallery, and creation space in Brooklyn, NY.
facts.exact_excerpt: Imagined by sustainable designers Amalya Meira and Logan Blagg , Lagoon New York is a concept store, gallery, and creation space based in Brooklyn, NY.

facts.text: Its custom-design service lets clients choose a silhouette and tailor the size, fabric, and colors.
facts.exact_excerpt: At Lagoon, both Amalya & Logan offer a custom design service within the styles they create. Select the silhouette of your choice and we can tailor the size and fabric/colors to you!

facts.text: Big event coming up? Costuming a performance/movie? Shooting your newest release?
facts.exact_excerpt: Big event coming up? Costuming a performance/movie? Shooting your newest release?

facts.text: If YOU are a stylist or looking to Pull looks from Lagoon ~ email us here!
facts.exact_excerpt: If YOU are a stylist or looking to Pull looks from Lagoon ~ email us here!

facts.text: In the Lagoon, Amalya and Logan’s wearable art is created & available for sale alongside a complementary curation in the realms of art, body, jewelry and housewares. The intention behind the space is grounded in sustainability, connection to nature and community engagement.
facts.exact_excerpt: In the Lagoon, Amalya and Logan’s wearable art is created & available for sale alongside a complementary curation in the realms of art, body, jewelry and housewares. The intention behind the space is grounded in sustainability, connection to nature and community engagement.
